nodes.title: SG-6 · Add contribution UI and admin console
nodes.body:
Context: the game frontend in game/frontend has a playable 80/20 App but no API client, contribution UI, countdown or admin routes. The backend already serves POST /api/v1/player/session, POST /api/v1/contributions, GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions, GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current and the Bearer-protected /api/v1/admin/* round and execution routes. Desired behavior: a Suggest What Happens Next sheet, a Round countdown and badge, and a token-gated admin console with lifecycle stepper and approve/retry controls. Expected result: all of it works against the existing API with Vitest tests using mocked fetch. Why: players feed the story and the admin runs the cycle without a terminal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the playing view, when the player opens the sheet and submits a prompt, then POST /api/v1/contributions is called and the entry appears in history
- Given a current Round, then the countdown shows time left and a status badge with the Round status
- Given no admin token entered, then admin routes render only the token form and make no admin request
- Given an admin Round, then the stepper marks the current stage among OPEN to COMPLETED
- Given a FAILED execution or AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Retry or Approve is clicked, then the matching admin endpoint is called with the Bearer token


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend React components, API client and Vitest tests
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: New backend endpoints such as reject, logs or test results
- Out of scope: New runtime dependencies
- Preserve: Existing App intro gate, GameLayout, StoryPanel behavior and tests
- Preserve: Only the typed admin token is used as a secret


## Technical constraints
- Frontend lives in game/frontend (no top-level frontend/ exists)
- fetch only, no secrets in env or bundle
- Vitest with mocked fetch


## Definition of done
- All five requirements delivered with passing unit tests
- npm test and tsc --noEmit pass in game/frontend


## Non-functional requirements
- Accessible roles and labels on controls


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Suggest What Happens Next sheet submits prompts and shows history
nodes.body:
Context: no contribution UI exists. Desired behavior: a Suggest What Happens Next button in the playing view opens a sheet with a textarea; submit creates an anonymous session if needed then POSTs the prompt; the sheet shows remaining contributions, a note that ideas are considered when the Round closes, and history with sending, sent and failed states. Expected result: errors from 401/409/429 show readable messages. Why: players steer the next release.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open, when a prompt is submitted, then fetch POST /api/v1/contributions receives world_id and prompt and the history lists it as sent
- Given the API answers 429 or 409, then the sheet shows an error message and the history entry is failed
- Given the sheet, then the text 'considered when the Round closes' and the remaining count are visible
- Given a 401 on submit, then a session is created via POST /api/v1/player/session and the submit is retried once


## Scope
- In scope: API client contribution calls
- In scope: ContributionSheet component
- In scope: App button wiring
- Out of scope: Backend remaining-count endpoint
- Preserve: Existing game flow


## Technical constraints
- Remaining = MAX_PER_PLAYER constant (5) minus history length since the API exposes no count
- credentials: include for cookies


## Definition of done
- Sheet usable from the playing view


## Non-functional requirements
- Textarea has an accessible label


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Admin routes sit behind token entry and manage the Round
nodes.body:
Context: no admin UI exists. Desired behavior: hash route #/admin renders AdminApp; without a token only a password-type token form shows; with a token it shows the World, the Round id/number/status, duration and max-contribution fields, Open and Close buttons calling POST /api/v1/admin/rounds/{id}/open|close?world=, and the contributions list from GET .../contributions. The token is held in component state only. Why: admins operate Rounds.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given no token, then only the token form renders and no admin fetch occurs
- Given a token submitted, then GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/{id} runs with header Authorization: Bearer <token>
- Given the Round, when Open or Close is clicked, then the matching POST runs with the world query
- Given contributions, then the list shows each prompt
- Given a 401 response, then the token form shows 'Invalid token'


## Scope
- In scope: AdminApp, TokenGate, admin client calls, hash routing in main/App
- Out of scope: Persisting the token
- Out of scope: Duration saved to server beyond POST /admin/rounds create
- Preserve: Player routes


## Technical constraints
- Admin Get uses ?world= query; duration sent as Go duration string on create
- Token never written to storage


## Dependencies
- REQ-2


## Definition of done
- #/admin gated


## Non-functional requirements
- Password input type


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Lifecycle stepper and execution details show Round progress
nodes.body:
Context: round statuses and /api/v1/admin/executions ({id,world_id,round_id,status,error,updated_at}) exist. Desired behavior: LifecycleStepper renders OPEN, CLOSED, ANALYZING, DEVELOPING, TESTING, PUBLISHING, COMPLETED, marking earlier stages done, the current stage with aria-current='step', and later stages pending; an ExecutionPanel shows contribution count, execution duration, agent logs, test results and release version when present, and the failure reason from error. Why: admins see where the cycle is.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given status DEVELOPING, then DEVELOPING has aria-current step, OPEN to ANALYZING are done and TESTING onward pending
- Given each of the seven statuses, then exactly that stage is current
- Given an execution with error 'build failed', then 'build failed' is shown as the failure reason
- Given log, test and release fields present, then they render, and absent fields render 'Not available'
- Given contributions N, then 'Contributions: N' is shown


## Scope
- In scope: LifecycleStepper, ExecutionPanel, listExecutions
- Out of scope: Backend fields for logs/tests/release
- Preserve: AdminApp


## Technical constraints
- Statuses PLANNING and BUILDING map to the DEVELOPING and TESTING stages respectively; FAILED shows the stage of the last known state as failed


## Dependencies
- REQ-3


## Definition of done
- Stepper visible in AdminApp


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Admin can approve and retry executions
nodes.body:
Context: POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve works for AWAITING_APPROVAL and /retry for FAILED, answering 409 otherwise. Desired behavior: ExecutionPanel shows Approve when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and Retry when FAILED, calls the endpoint, reloads executions, and shows the 409 message on conflict. There is no reject endpoint, so no Reject call is made. Why: admin supervises publishing.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given AWAITING_APPROVAL, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve runs with the Bearer header
- Given FAILED, when Retry is clicked, then POST .../retry runs
- Given other statuses, then neither button renders
- Given a 409, then the error text is shown and buttons remain


## Scope
- In scope: approveExecution, retryExecution, buttons
- Out of scope: Reject endpoint
- Preserve: Stepper


## Technical constraints
- Reject is excluded because the backend lacks it


## Dependencies
- REQ-4


## Definition of done
- Controls working


## Clarifying questions
- The backend has no reject endpoint; should Reject be added later as a backend ticket?
